metadata.title: Clicked like a confused cat and somehow scared off 1 unlucky soul? Valorant chaos unlocked
metadata.description:
Clicking like I forgot it was a shooter
That 1 poor enemy probably thinking ‘What just happened?’
Did NOT deserve that accidental scare but hey, free chaos!
Tap if your aim’s mostly happy accidents too!

Tap if your aim’s 90% accident and 10% pure luck!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
